subject: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement path (Cyclone AI)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Annie Chen <annie@cycloneai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement path (Cyclone AI)

Hi Annie — thanks again for taking time earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Demo highlights (what we showed):
- Low-latency hosted inference for customer-facing features (avg 120ms p95 on our hosted tier).
- Dedicated capacity option for predictable throughput and data isolation (useful for regulated pipelines).
- Built-in rollout controls (canary / A/B) and cost tooling we think will help your ops team.

Decision criteria you mentioned: latency SLOs, ability to pin model versions, and a simple procurement path. You also flagged data residency and audit logging as blockers for security.

Requested items / asks from your side:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer / budget owner we should bring into the next call?
2) Could you share a short procurement timeline and any standard SOW/PO requirements?
3) Any specific security questionnaire items we should prepare for the security/legal team (SOC2 scope, data residency)?

Attachments: pricing + SOC2 summary + proposed MVP scope (short docs attached).

Proposed next steps:
- We’d like to schedule a 30-min call next week with Maya (VP Finance) and someone from procurement + security to finalize budget and timeline.
- Laura will prepare a one-pager tailored to the buyer that highlights cost predictability and pilot options.
- Dev will add a draft canary rollout plan showing fallback behavior in the event of failures.

If you can confirm the names/emails for Maya and procurement and propose 3 times, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Annie Chen <annie@cycloneai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kline <david.k@cycloneai.com>, procurement@cycloneai.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement path (Cyclone AI)

Thanks Sean — great demo yesterday. Quick answers while I pull the rest together.

Economic buyer / budget owner: Maya Kapoor, VP Finance (maya.kapoor@cycloneai.com). She handles platform spend and will want a short ROI doc.
Procurement contact: procurement@cycloneai.com (the mailbox routes to our procurement ops team).
Security/legal: looping in David Kline (security lead) — his team will want the SOC2 summary and details on audit logs and data residency. Our major constraint is that any production data processed for EU customers must stay in our EU region or be encrypted and audited.

Proposed slots for the budget + procurement call:
- Tue 16 Mar, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 17 Mar, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 18 Mar, 09:00–09:30 PT

We’d like to see a short one-pager that calls out: pilot scope, expected unit economics, rollback/fallback behavior, and the minimal security artifacts you can share now.

On attachments: I received the SOC2 summary and the pricing doc — thanks. Please also include an explicit pilot success criteria section.

Best,
Annie
Head of GTM Operations
Cyclone AI
annie@cycloneai.com

Sean / Dev — quick internal notes before the call with Maya/procurement: 

- Pricing flexibility: offer a 6-week pilot with a capped spend (e.g., $25k) and optional conversion to dedicated capacity — this reduces budget friction for Finance.
- Security: share SOC2 summary now (we did) and prepare a short slide on data residency options (hosted + EU region vs private VPC).
- Decision criteria doc: I can draft a 1-page buyer brief that speaks to total cost of ownership and SLA options. Will include a clear success-criteria checklist (latency, traffic levels, error budget).

Action items for this thread:
- Laura: create buyer one-pager by EOD Wed.
- Dev: put together a brief canary/fallback outline (single slide) — include KV cache warmup time and expected cold-start behavior.
- Sean: confirm meeting time with Cyclone and include Maya + procurement + David from security.

Laura

Redwood Inference
